$schema_note: Claude Code project settings. Hooks are Node scripts invoked as 'node .claude/hooks/x.mjs' so they fire identically in the Claude desktop app on Windows, in WSL, in a terminal, and in CI (node is on PATH in all of them). No chmod or shell dependency needed. The Stop hook enforces the Definition of Done; set REMEDIATION_GATE=off to bypass during exploratory work.
